components.name: Ticket
components.description: Queue ticket with the number as the focal element.

narrative.overview: A modern, characterful take on the neighbourhood barbershop: a dim, warm room, brass fixtures, one hot ember of orange, and a frosted-glass interface layer floating over it. Glass is the stated direction; today it exists only in the nav and dialog backdrop.
keyCharacteristics: Dark espresso default with a warm light paper theme
Brass for primary actions, ember orange as rare accent
Tonal layering with large diffuse shadows
Teal is an optional alternate scheme

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Orange is a glow and a signal, not a fill.

rules.name: The Both Modes Rule
rules.body: Every colour decision is made twice, dark and light, with contrast verified in both.

rules.name: The Number First Rule
rules.body: On customer and display surfaces the queue number is the hero.

rules.name: The Diffuse Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows spread wide and soft; no tight dark offsets.

dos: Do use Brass for primary actions and Ember sparingly for glow and selection.
Do verify contrast in both dark and light themes.
Do keep the ticket number the largest element on customer and display surfaces.
Do extend glass (blur plus translucent tint) deliberately on floating layers.
donts: Don't fill large areas with orange.
Don't use tight, hard drop shadows.
Don't treat the teal scheme as canonical.
Don't hard-code the shop name or palette in new components.
